title: Mystical Stained Glass Pyramid
description: A large triangular stained glass pyramid floats centrally against a dramatic, cloudy night sky. The pyramid features intricate green, brown, and multicolored glass panels with glowing internal light, surrounded by floating golden alchemical and occult symbols, with colorful bokeh orbs scattered throughout the scene.
prompt: A large triangular stained glass pyramid floats in a dramatic cloudy night sky with swirling dark green and orange clouds. The pyramid is composed of intricate glowing green and multicolored glass panels with occult patterns. Golden alchemical symbols, runes, and sigils float around the pyramid. Colorful translucent bokeh orbs in red, orange, and green drift throughout the scene, creating a mystical and ethereal atmosphere.
